cases.prompt: The product cards in packages/web look bare and generic. Give the catalog a polished, production-ready look that still fits the colors and components the store already uses.
Explain how useCart in packages/web keeps the cart between visits, and what happens when the stored value is not valid JSON.

When Hide sold out leaves nothing to show, the catalog in packages/web only says 'No products match.' Design a proper empty state as a reusable component and use it there, in line with the rest of the store. It is a small UI change, so do it directly.
cases.review: The answer takes stock first: the components in packages/web/src/components, the colors from @shop/design-tokens that StockBadge.tsx uses, the BEM-like class names, and the fact that no stylesheet for those classes is in the repo. It builds a reusable empty-state component next to the others (exported from components/index.ts if it follows that convention) and uses it in ProductGrid.tsx. The empty state says why it is empty (sold-out items are hidden) and offers one action that widens the result (show sold-out items, by unchecking the filter), without breaking the existing Loading and error states. Colors come from the design tokens or existing classes, not new hard-coded hex values, and no new styling system or dependency appears; any new style is flagged for approval. Semantic markup (a heading or text plus a real button), visible focus, and a design note with direction, tokens, states and what to check in a browser.
